dds_burst_control.command: cmd_valid one-cycle request; accepted/rejected pulse; accepted only idle, positive PW/count, PRI>=PW, future GSC with same modulo-4 phase, train-end representable
dds_burst_control.time: start_gsc is source-stage sample time, not physical RF reference; integration must deduct NCO/TXCAL/interpolation/adapter latency
dds_burst_control.envelope: rectangular, end-exclusive, PW and PRI in 125MHz samples
dds_burst_control.chirp: 48-bit modular PINC increment on each active sample; PINC returns to initial at each pulse end and holds initial through PRI gap
dds_burst_control.phase: phase_reset at first train sample and optionally each pulse; nco_enable continues through PRI gaps, allowing phase accumulation at initial PINC; reset_each_pulse=0 preserves deterministic continuous phase across gaps
dds_burst_control.abort: combinational gate/enable suppression, busy clears and done pulses next edge
limitations: GSC must be monotonic +4 in one stable clock epoch; reset/abort on epoch change
No pulse shaping beyond rectangular envelope

dds_nco_wrapper.catalog_deviation: Standalone fallback selected rather than generated AMD DDS Compiler; no claim that catalog IP wrapper has been generated
dds_nco_wrapper.semantics: On enabled edge, output current selected phase (zero if phase_reset), then accumulate PINC. Positive PINC rotates cos+j sin counterclockwise; reset ignored when disabled; disabled emits zero and invalid. Envelope=0 emits valid zero while phase advances.
dds_nco_wrapper.precision: 10-bit phase truncation, no interpolation/dither/SFDR or full-band analog certification
dds_nco_wrapper.enable: Connect dds_burst_control nco_enable, envelope, phase_reset, pinc; no stream backpressure

awg_reader.load_domain: clk_rf ONLY: upstream clk_ctrl asynchronous FIFO/handshake bridge REQUIRED
awg_reader.load_protocol: load_begin with length/CRC snapshot, then exactly length words on load_valid && load_ready; sequential writes only inactive bank; new load may replace uncommitted candidate; ready deasserts on final word
awg_reader.crc: CRC32C reflected polynomial 0x82f63b78, init 0xffffffff, final complement, low byte and low bit first within each 64-bit word
awg_reader.commit_protocol: commit requests a verified complete table; pending blocks load; safe_boundary && !playing && !play atomically swaps bank and pulses commit_ack; old active table remains usable on failed load
awg_reader.playback: play pulse while active_valid and !playing; first registered word one edge after accepted play; exactly active_len consecutive words, no ready/backpressure; out_last on final word; idle outputs zero/invalid
limitations: No clk_ctrl/AXI/PS bridge inside module; this is a single-domain memory core, not complete dual-clock catalog wrapper
No absolute GSC scheduler inside AWG; upstream must align play with fixed one-edge first-word latency
No looping or per-table gain; these need scheduler/processing integration

tx_source_mux.request: single pending slot; latch request until safe_boundary; accepted pulses on applied switch; pending/full/invalid/OTA-LIVE rejects explicitly
tx_source_mux.safety: rf_permit=0 or reset produces immediate zero codes and valid; selected LIVE also forced zero whenever single_antenna_ota asserted; no physical RF control
tx_source_mux.valid: MUTE/safety zero valid=1; enabled selected input propagates valid, invalid input always data=0
tx_source_mux.integration: output -> tx_channel_router -> per-DAC tx_cal_executor -> tx_interp4_wrapper -> rfdac_stream_adapter; all source modes share this path
